toolVersions.tooling: scratch TEMP venv + stdlib-only scripts (no numpy, no Docker, no Blender)

derivative.format: glTF 2.0 binary (GLB), 1 mesh(es), TRIANGLES primitives, non-indexed soup
derivative.material: layoutlab-fallback-environment_floor_a01: baseColor [0.55, 0.56, 0.58, 1.0], metallic 0.0, roughness 0.9, doubleSided true
derivative.axisMap: (x, y, z)Z-up -> (x, z, -y)Y-up (proper rotation, det +1; winding preserved)
derivative.scaleBaked: none: GLB keeps source meters; placement scaling applied in the browser per placement rule

placement: position (3.0, -0.100008, 3.0)m, scale 1.0: true 6.0x6.0m slab, top surface at y=0, spans room bounds exactly.
discardedFeatures: SimReady physics payloads and MuJoCo/Newton/PhysX variants (GLB conversion does NOT preserve SimReady physics metadata)
MDL materials (OmniPBR.mdl) and PNG/UDIM textures (never downloaded; original MDL not preserved)
UVs (present in source, unused by the untextured fallback material)
